**fix(memory): reindex parity between backends is already true; add cross-backend test coverage (#361)**

Verified both asymmetries #361 named (engram.share() conditional reindex, engram.pull() never reindexing) were independently closed before this work started: pull reindex via #574 (a029ed0a), share unconditional reindex via #874 split B (56de7408). No production code change needed. Added brain/scripts/memory/backends/reindex-parity.test.mjs (cross-backend share+pull-path unconditional reindex parity) and two new tests in engram.pull.test.mjs pinning pullMemory()'s previously-untested Step 3 reindex. Mutation-proved: reverting each fix independently makes exactly the intended new tests go RED, restore confirms GREEN. Full npm test: 5316/5316 (baseline 5311 + 5 new). Ticked epic task 4.1 in issue-864-memory-2-0/tasks.md.
